mobile_access_custom_detail: One sentence under the Custom level. {scopes} is the held permissions in lower case, separated by semicolons.
mobile_access_custom_label: Summary level of a phone with some of the permissions. {count} is how many it holds, {total} how many exist.
mobile_access_full_detail: One sentence under the Full access level. The prompts are the permission prompts an agent raises before it runs a tool.
mobile_access_full_label: Summary level of a phone that holds all five permissions.
mobile_access_none_detail: One sentence under the No access level.
mobile_access_none_label: Summary level of a phone with no permission.
mobile_access_view_detail: One sentence under View only when the phone cannot watch terminals.
mobile_access_view_label: Summary level of a phone that may only read.
mobile_access_view_terminals_detail: One sentence under View only when the phone can watch terminals.
mobile_activity_action: Phone activity entry for an action that named no key.
mobile_activity_action_key: Phone activity entry. {key} is the action key from atlas.yaml.
mobile_activity_approved: Phone activity entry: the phone answered an agent permission prompt with allow.
mobile_activity_denied: Phone activity entry: the phone answered an agent permission prompt with deny.

mobile_activity_git_commit.description: Phone activity entry: a git commit.
mobile_activity_git_commit.distinct: an activity entry (what the phone did); the other is the success toast of a commit

mobile_activity_git_push: Phone activity entry: a git push.
mobile_activity_launch: Phone activity entry. {name} is the id of the agent that started.
mobile_activity_launch_unnamed: Phone activity entry for an agent start that named no agent.
mobile_activity_pair: Phone activity entry: the phone paired.
mobile_activity_prompt: Phone activity entry: a prompt, with no size recorded.
mobile_activity_prompt_size: Phone activity entry: a prompt. {count} is its length in characters; the text itself is never kept.
mobile_activity_ran_op: Phone activity entry for a service operation Atlas has no word for. {op} is the operation id, {target} a service name or the stack.
mobile_activity_ran_operation: Phone activity entry for a service operation that named no operation. {target} is a service name or the stack.
mobile_activity_restarted: Phone activity entry. {target} is a service name, or the stack.
mobile_activity_started: Phone activity entry. {target} is a service name, or the stack.
mobile_activity_stopped: Phone activity entry. {target} is a service name, or the stack.
mobile_activity_terminal_write: Phone activity entry: typing in a terminal, with no size recorded.
mobile_activity_terminal_write_size: Phone activity entry: typing in a terminal. {count} is the size of what was typed in bytes; the text itself is never kept.
mobile_activity_the_stack: Target of a phone service operation that named no service: the whole stack. Inserted into the restarted, started and stopped entries.
mobile_activity_unknown: Phone activity entry for an audit line with an empty command name. Any other unknown command is shown by its raw name.
mobile_device_status_connected: Line under a paired phone's name while it is connected. {paired} is the pairing date.
mobile_device_status_never: Line under a paired phone's name when it never connected after pairing. {paired} is the pairing date.
mobile_device_status_seen: Line under a paired phone's name while it is offline. {seen} is relative time such as 3 min ago, {paired} the pairing date.
mobile_device_title: Name of a paired phone that never got a name. {id} is the first four characters of its key, such as A3F9.
mobile_pair_card_code_expired: Title of the empty QR frame in the pair card once the one-time code ran out.
mobile_pair_card_code_lifetime: Explains the expired state of the pair card: a pairing code lasts 120 seconds.
mobile_pair_card_code_placeholder: Caption of the empty QR frame in the pair card before a code was requested.
mobile_pair_card_copy_link: Button that copies the pairing link, for a phone that cannot scan the QR code.
mobile_pair_card_error_body: Body of the pairing error alert. {error} is the reason hostd gave, in English.
mobile_pair_card_error_title: Title of the error alert when hostd could not start pairing.
mobile_pair_card_expires_in: Countdown next to the one-time code. {time} is minutes and seconds as m:ss.
mobile_pair_card_link_copied: Toast after Copy link. Paste link is a button of the phone app (English only for now), so it stays as the phone shows it.
mobile_pair_card_new_code: Button that replaces the pairing code with a fresh one.
mobile_pair_card_one_time_code: Accessible name of the six-digit pairing code.
mobile_pair_card_pair_another: Main button of the pair card right after a phone paired.
mobile_pair_card_paired_body: Body of the success alert after a phone paired; the list is Paired phones, below the card.
mobile_pair_card_paired_title: Title of the success alert after a phone paired. {paired} is the name of the phone.
mobile_pair_card_show_code: Main button of the pair card when no code is live. Also named in the Mobile settings empty state.
mobile_pair_card_step_get: Step 1 of the pair card: install the Atlas Mobile app on the phone.
mobile_pair_card_step_get_how: Link text after the testing hint of step 1; opens the mobile docs page.
mobile_pair_card_step_get_testing: Hint of step 1 while Atlas Mobile has no public App Store or Google Play listing.
mobile_pair_card_step_open: Step 2 of the pair card: open Atlas Mobile on the phone.
mobile_pair_card_step_open_hint: Hint of step 2. The two emphasized names are buttons of the phone app (apps/mobile, English only for now), so they stay as the phone shows them; the markup tag em wraps each one.
mobile_pair_card_step_scan: Step 3 of the pair card: scan the QR code with the phone.
mobile_pair_card_step_scan_hint: Hint of step 3. The emphasized name is the Paired phones group heading of the Mobile settings (mobile_settings), right below the card.
mobile_pair_card_time_left: Accessible name of the progress bar that counts down the pairing code.
mobile_pair_card_waiting: Status line under a live pairing code, until the phone scans it.
mobile_pair_help_addrs: Line in the pairing help that introduces the direct network addresses the code carries. {count} is how many; the addresses follow after the colon.
mobile_pair_help_awake: Second pairing tip. The bold lead is wrapped in the markup tag b.
mobile_pair_help_title: Title of the collapsible help under the pair card.
mobile_pair_help_vpn: Third pairing tip. The bold question is wrapped in the markup tag b; a docs link follows it.
mobile_pair_help_vpn_docs: Link text under the VPN tip; opens the matching section of the mobile docs.
mobile_pair_help_wifi: First pairing tip. The bold lead sentence is wrapped in the markup tag b.
mobile_pair_qr_expired: Shown in place of the pairing QR code when the one-time code ran out.
mobile_pair_qr_expires_in: Countdown under the pairing QR code in the crew server settings. {left} is the seconds left on the one-time code.
mobile_pair_qr_label: Accessible name of the QR code image the phone scans to pair with this computer.
mobile_phone_activity_empty: Empty state of the phone activity list: says which actions of the phone will be listed.
mobile_phone_activity_error: Shown when hostd could not read the phone's audit log. {error} is the reason, in English.
mobile_phone_activity_footer: Footer of the phone activity list. {count} is how many entries are shown (at most 20).
mobile_phone_activity_label: Accessible name of the list of what a phone did lately.
mobile_phone_activity_reading: Loading line while the phone's audit log is read.
mobile_phone_activity_try_again: Button after the activity read failed.
mobile_phone_row_activity: Button in a paired phone row that opens what the phone did lately.
mobile_phone_row_connected_now: Tooltip of the phone icon in a paired phone row while a stream from the phone is open.
mobile_phone_row_edit_permissions: Title of the collapsible that holds the permission switches of one phone.
mobile_phone_row_name_description: Explains the rename dialog: the name stays on this computer.
mobile_phone_row_name_label: Label of the phone name field in the rename dialog.
mobile_phone_row_name_placeholder: Example name in the phone name field: a person's phone.
mobile_phone_row_name_title: Title of the rename dialog of a paired phone.
mobile_phone_row_not_connected: Tooltip of the phone icon in a paired phone row while the phone is offline.
mobile_phone_row_unpair: Button that removes a paired phone (also the confirm button of the Unpair dialog).
mobile_phone_row_unpair_body: Body of the Unpair confirm dialog: what happens to the phone.
mobile_phone_row_unpair_title: Title of the confirm dialog. {title} is the name of the phone.
mobile_phone_row_unpaired: Toast after a phone was unpaired. {title} is the name of the phone.
mobile_scope_act_label: Permission switch (scope act) of a paired phone. Also joined into the Custom access summary in lower case.
mobile_scope_act_risk: What granting the act permission risks.
mobile_scope_approve_label: Permission switch (scope approve) of a paired phone. Also joined into the Custom access summary in lower case.
mobile_scope_approve_risk: What granting the approve permission risks.
mobile_scope_group_control: Heading of the group of permissions that let a paired phone change things.
mobile_scope_group_view: Heading of the group of read-only permissions of a paired phone.
mobile_scope_read_label: Permission switch (scope read) of a paired phone. Also joined into the Custom access summary in lower case.
mobile_scope_read_risk: What granting the read permission risks.
mobile_scope_term_read_label: Permission switch (scope term_read) of a paired phone. Also joined into the Custom access summary in lower case.
mobile_scope_term_read_risk: What granting the terminal watching permission risks.
mobile_scope_term_write_label: Permission switch (scope term_write) of a paired phone. Also joined into the Custom access summary in lower case.
mobile_scope_term_write_risk: What granting the terminal typing permission risks.
